question: The emotional depictions of the female characters you write, including Petra in Arc 9, are so perceptive that I'm always surprised by how well you understand them despite being a male author. I assume Emilia is your favorite female character, but conversely, if you yourself were a woman and had to choose a male character you'd want to date, who would you choose?
answer:
Are you asking who I'd want to date based on my understanding of a girl's heart!? (laughs)

I'm the author of Re, so I know all the good and bad points of every character... Who would it be? There's a points-for and points-against system, right?

...Garfiel, I guess (laughs).

That boy is just nothing but a good person. He has so much room for growth, and he's devoted. I mean, I can only think of good things about him! With all the other characters, I can think of little bad things here and there—especially when it comes to romance. But with Garfiel, I can only think of good things.

Even the Alive side story I'm working on right now (*) brings out so many of Garfiel's good qualities. Garfiel is number one. Ram should choose Garfiel!! (laughs)
